# metadata.validate_aggregate { #healpyxel.metadata.validate_aggregate }

```python
metadata.validate_aggregate(df, meta, expected_columns=None, strict=True)
```

Validate aggregate DataFrame structure.

Comprehensive validation of the aggregate DataFrame: index name,
row count vs npix, cell ID range, no duplicates, sequential index
for dense maps, expected columns, ``n_sources`` sanity, and finite
values in statistic columns.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                | Description                                                    | Default    |
|------------------|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| df               | pd.DataFrame        | Aggregate DataFrame with ``healpix_id`` as index.              | _required_ |
| meta             | HEALPyxelxMetadata  | Expected HEALPix metadata for validation.                      | _required_ |
| expected_columns | list\[str\] or None | Optional list of expected statistic column names to check for. | `None`     |
| strict           | bool                | If True, raise ``AssertionError`` on validation failures.      | `True`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | Validation results with keys: ``valid``, ``errors``, ``warnings``, ``n_rows``, ``is_sparse``, ``is_dense``, and optionally ``n_sources_min``, ``n_sources_max``, ``n_sources_mean``. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type           | Description                              |
|--------|----------------|------------------------------------------|
|        | AssertionError | If ``strict=True`` and validation fails. |
